concerns.text: User Story 1 (Dynamic Baseline Extraction) has a functional requirement (FR‑001) but no success criteria are linked to it; all SC‑### entries reference US‑3 only.
User Story 2 (Static Index Construction) is backed by FR‑002 yet lacks any success criteria; the SC list is anchored solely to US‑3.

FR-008 specifies a sensitivity analysis sweeping the cluster count K over the set {50, 100, 200}, but the Assumptions section later states “A sensitivity analysis will sweep K ∈ {, low, high}” (missing values) and also mentions “unless the idea specifies otherwise”. These contradictory definitions of the K sweep range create ambiguity about the required experimental protocol.

The Assumptions paragraph contains an incomplete set notation “K ∈ {, low, high}” and conflicts with FR-008’s explicit set {50, 100, 200}. This inconsistency must be resolved to a single, unambiguous definition of the K values to be evaluated.
